technical-summary: PRQ06 step 3 (retirements). rad0003 and rad0007 set rejected (tested, not accepted: MTP acceptance 0.63-0.65 vs 0.62-0.64; FP8 down path 1203.7 us vs 530.7 us at M=2048) and rad0039 recorded abandoned (RHP02 slice A only, consumer never built), then all three moved unchanged into engines/radiance/patches/archive/ with ARCHIVE.md rows. Their experiments are removed from recipes.toml; rad0039's host ABI test and package test moved into its archive folder and the r3_heat_observer_abi_test ctest target is dropped; RAD15 and RHP02 deprecated with pointers to the archive. Recipes gain the diagnostic source radiance-vtp44-evidence (patch-set vtp44-evidence: rad0042-rad0045) so those four can be classified diagnostic by patch-promote --diagnostic next. Decision owner: lead 2026-11-20. No state, content or digest of any remaining patch changed.
